name: Three-chamber sociability
description: A box divided into three chambers, with an unfamiliar animal in a cage on one side and an empty cage or object on the other. Measures social preference: typical animals spend more time near the other animal than near the object.

parameters.label: Chamber width
parameters.help: Inside width of one chamber, from the outer wall to the partition. It is only used to check the drawn zones, not in the calculations.

parameters.label: Chamber depth
parameters.help: Inside depth of one chamber, front wall to back wall. It is only used to check the drawn zones, not in the calculations.

parameters.label: Tracking gap tolerance
parameters.help: If the animal is lost for longer than this, the movement across the gap is not counted. Raise it only for low frame rate videos.

zones.label: Object chamber
zones.geometry: Chamber with the empty cage or object.

zones.label: Social interaction area
zones.geometry: Close-interaction area around the stimulus cage.

zones.label: Object interaction area
zones.geometry: Close-interaction area around the object cage.

events.label: Social chamber visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in social_chamber.

events.label: Object chamber visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in object_chamber.

events.label: Center chamber visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in center_chamber.

events.label: Social interaction area visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in social_interaction.

events.label: Object interaction area visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in object_interaction.

events.label: Social chamber entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering social_chamber.

events.label: Object chamber entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering object_chamber.

events.label: Center chamber entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering center_chamber.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.description: Time during which the animal could be tracked.
metrics.definition: Samples and calibrated zone shapes use the same coordinates in centimeters; zones are evaluated independently and include their boundary. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in social chamber
metrics.description: Time spent in the chamber with the other animal.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the social chamber.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in object chamber
metrics.description: Time spent in the chamber with the empty cage or object.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the object chamber.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in center chamber
metrics.description: Time spent in the middle chamber.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the center chamber.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Sociability index
metrics.description: Preference for the social chamber over the object chamber, from -1 (only object) to +1 (only social); values near 0 mean no preference.
metrics.definition: Preference for the social chamber, from -1 (object) to +1 (social).
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when both chamber times are 0; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Social interaction time
metrics.description: Time spent close to the cage with the other animal.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the social interaction zone.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZONE_NOT_PROVIDED) when the interaction zone is not calibrated; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Object interaction time
metrics.description: Time spent close to the empty cage or object.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the object interaction zone.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZONE_NOT_PROVIDED) when the interaction zone is not calibrated; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Social chamber entries
metrics.description: How many times the animal walked into the social chamber.
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Object chamber entries
metrics.description: How many times the animal walked into the object chamber.
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.
